title: Influence of Different Rehydration Protocols on Biomechanical Properties of Allogeneic Cortical Bone Plates: A Combined in-vitro/in-vivo
authors: Study Pabst, A., Ackermann, M., Thiem, D., & Kämmerer, P . (2021). Journal of investigative surgery : the official journal of the Academy of Surgical Research, 34(10), 1158–1164.
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss maxgraft (processed human allograft) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “The biomechanical properties of CP can be significantly improved by 10 min of rehydration, resulting in an increased BS and FX, that might be clinically relevant” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
